title: FINAL F5 + F5w (M3 draft, functional only): nativefinal-bin plain launch on the W8a route; fx5 = first launch (cold cache, records recipes), fx5w = second launch in its own run dir, seeded with fx5's cache (native-pso-recipes.bin + native-pso.bin only)
notes: M10 final-defaults-rating C20B6FDB F5 + M10 final-gate-rating AE8EB2A5 G1: exactly one launch per run dir. fx5w runs in its own run dir; run-timing -SeedCache copies only native-pso.bin + native-pso-recipes.bin from fx5's run-dir cache\ into fx5w's cache\ before launch (game not started if either is missing) and records seed_cache {requested, source_dir, dest, files[name, source, bytes, sha256]} in fx5w's run.json. No logs are carried over.

W8a route = plain launch, cvars native_settings_frontend=false, native_fps_limit=0, framerate_limit=0 (as matrix-window8a.json arm n0), window 5 s settle + 55 s warm-up from the first frame + 50 s. No LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE in either arm (plain launch = build default ON).

Hidden desktop (s4b-queue): functional only, the numbers are not timing results. Gate: build/agent12/session3/final_gate.py <fx5 run> F5 --ref build/agent8/matrix/20261125-0359/runs/0400-n0-r1; <fx5w run> F5w --first <fx5 run> --ref <same n0>.
